milestones.text: learned the first basic steps of {hobby}
milestones.post: First steps learned. Feet still confused, but willing.

milestones.text: made it through a whole first lesson without giving up
milestones.post: First lesson done. Two left feet, both still attached.

milestones.text: stopped looking at their feet for a whole minute
milestones.post: Looked up from my feet for a full minute. Huge.

milestones.text: counted the beats out loud and mostly stayed on them
milestones.post: Counted out loud like a beginner. Because I am one.

milestones.text: turned the wrong way only twice in an evening of {hobby}
milestones.post: Only turned the wrong way twice. A record.

milestones.text: went back for a second lesson despite feeling clumsy at the first
milestones.post: Felt clumsy, went back anyway. Stubbornness pays.

milestones.text: practised the basic step in the kitchen until it finally stuck
milestones.post: Kitchen practice paid off. The kettle saw everything.

milestones.text: found the beat in the music on their own for the first time
milestones.post: Heard the beat and found it myself. Small, lovely moment.

milestones.text: got through a whole dance without stopping
milestones.post: Whole dance, start to finish, no stopping.

milestones.text: remembered a full sequence of steps from one week to the next
milestones.post: Remembered the whole sequence after a week. Amazed.

milestones.text: stopped counting under their breath
milestones.post: No more counting under my breath. Mostly.

milestones.text: added a little flourish of their own to the basic step
milestones.post: Added my own little flourish. Very subtle. Very me.

milestones.text: danced in front of friends without feeling self-conscious
milestones.post: Danced in front of friends and didn't want to hide.

milestones.text: learned their first turn and came out of it facing the right way
milestones.post: Turned, and came out facing the right way. Ta-da.

milestones.text: kept dancing after a stumble instead of stopping
milestones.post: Stumbled, kept going. Nobody noticed. I think.

milestones.text: got a compliment on their timing from the teacher
milestones.post: Teacher said my timing was good. Floating home.

milestones.text: learned a new routine in a single evening
milestones.post: New routine, one evening. My brain is fizzing.

milestones.text: helped a newcomer find the beat
milestones.post: Helped a beginner find the beat. Paying it forward.

milestones.text: danced every dance of the night and still wanted more
milestones.post: Danced all night and could have kept going.

milestones.text: moved up to the intermediate group
milestones.post: Intermediate group now. Terrified and thrilled.

milestones.text: found they could follow the music instead of just the steps
milestones.post: Stopped dancing steps and started dancing the music.

milestones.text: had a night where every single step felt easy
milestones.post: One of those nights where every step just flowed.

milestones.text: danced well enough that people stopped to watch
milestones.post: People stopped to watch. In a good way, I'm told.

milestones.text: worked out a tricky sequence entirely on their own
milestones.post: Cracked the tricky bit alone. Very pleased with myself.

milestones.text: performed at their first showcase
milestones.post: First showcase. Nerves, lights, and then pure joy.

milestones.text: was asked to help teach the beginners
milestones.post: Helping teach the beginners now. Full circle.

milestones.text: danced in their first competition and made the second round
milestones.post: Made it to the second round! Didn't expect that.

milestones.text: choreographed a short piece for a few friends
milestones.post: Made up my own little piece. Friends danced it. Wow.

milestones.text: led the warm-up for the whole group
milestones.post: Led the warm-up. Everyone followed. Power.

milestones.text: danced a whole evening without a single wrong step
milestones.post: A whole evening, no wrong steps. Honestly.

milestones.text: danced at a friend's wedding and got the whole room up
milestones.post: Got the whole wedding dancing. Mission accomplished.

milestones.text: was picked for the front row at the end-of-season show
milestones.post: Front row at the show. Gulp.

milestones.text: won first place in a dance competition
milestones.post: First place. I danced my heart out and it showed.

milestones.text: danced a solo in front of a full house
milestones.post: A solo, a full house, a standing ovation. Pinch me.

milestones.text: taught their own class for a whole season
milestones.post: A whole season teaching my own class. Who knew?

milestones.text: was invited to dance with the best troupe in town
milestones.post: Invited to dance with the best in town. Still reeling.

milestones.text: choreographed the opening number for the annual show
milestones.post: My choreography opened the show. Watched from the wings, beaming.

milestones.text: was asked to judge a beginners' competition
milestones.post: Judging beginners now. Gave everyone kind marks.

milestones.text: marked five years of {hobby} with their best performance yet
milestones.post: Five years dancing. Best performance yet.

milestones.text: had strangers ask where they had learned to dance like that
milestones.post: A stranger asked who taught me. Proud of my teachers.

milestones.text: learned the basic salsa step on one
milestones.post: Salsa basic, on one. Hips have a mind of their own.

milestones.text: made it through their first salsa social
milestones.post: First salsa social. Danced with four people. Survived.

milestones.text: managed a cross-body lead without anyone getting tangled
milestones.post: Cross-body lead, no tangles. Smooth operator.

milestones.text: danced with a stranger at a salsa night and kept the beat
milestones.post: Danced with a stranger and stayed on the beat.

milestones.text: pulled off a clean double turn on a crowded floor
milestones.post: Double turn, crowded floor, no collisions.

milestones.text: kept their timing through a really fast salsa song
milestones.post: That song was so fast. Kept up anyway.

milestones.text: danced in a team performance at the summer salsa festival
milestones.post: Team performance at the festival. Glitter everywhere.

milestones.text: learned a full shines routine and danced it solo
milestones.post: Shines routine, solo. Feet flying.

milestones.text: won the amateur salsa contest at the local festival
milestones.post: Won the amateur contest. Still dancing in the kitchen.

milestones.text: was asked to join the studio's performance team
milestones.post: Performance team! All those socials paid off.

milestones.text: learned the basic Lindy Hop swing-out
milestones.post: Swing-out learned. Felt like a dizzy spin, in a good way.

milestones.text: made it through their first swing dance social
milestones.post: First swing social. The band was brilliant. I was not. Yet.

milestones.text: danced a whole Charleston without running out of breath
milestones.post: A whole Charleston. Breathless, but standing.

milestones.text: kept up through a fast big-band number
milestones.post: Big band, fast tempo, and I kept up.

milestones.text: stepped into the jam circle for a few bars
milestones.post: Jumped into the jam circle. Brief, but glorious.

milestones.text: learned the whole Shim Sham and danced it with the room
milestones.post: Whole room doing the Shim Sham, me included.

milestones.text: entered their first Jack and Jill contest
milestones.post: Jack and Jill contest. Random partner, great fun.

milestones.text: danced till the last song at the big Saturday night ball
milestones.post: Danced to the last song. Shoes worn through.

milestones.text: won the swing contest at the dance hall
milestones.post: Won the swing contest. The band played us off.

milestones.text: danced a showcase routine with a live band playing
milestones.post: Danced our routine to a live band. Unforgettable.

milestones.text: learned the box step of the waltz
milestones.post: Box step mastered. Round and round we go.

milestones.text: got through a whole waltz without treading on anyone's toes
milestones.post: A whole waltz, no toes trodden on. Everyone's relieved.

milestones.text: danced a polka round the whole floor
milestones.post: Polka all the way round. Dizzy and delighted.

milestones.text: kept a proper frame through a whole waltz
milestones.post: Frame held the whole waltz. Posture of a statue.

milestones.text: learned a smooth natural turn in the waltz
milestones.post: Natural turn, smooth as anything. Practising forever.

milestones.text: danced every set at the assembly and never missed a figure
milestones.post: Every set, every figure. My card was full.

milestones.text: danced in their first ballroom competition
milestones.post: First ballroom competition. Smiled through every step.

milestones.text: opened the floor at the season's ball
milestones.post: We opened the ball. Everyone watching. No pressure.

milestones.text: won the waltz at a ballroom competition
milestones.post: Won the waltz. Spun off the floor in a daze.

milestones.text: was asked to demonstrate the waltz at the grand ball
milestones.post: Demonstrated the waltz at the grand ball. Very grand.

milestones.text: learned the shuffle-ball-change
milestones.post: Shuffle-ball-change. Say it fast. Do it faster.

milestones.text: bought their first pair of tap shoes
milestones.post: My own tap shoes. The neighbours are thrilled, surely.

milestones.text: tapped a whole time step cleanly
milestones.post: Clean time step. Every tap where it should be.

milestones.text: kept up with the piano in a fast tap number
milestones.post: Piano went fast, so did my feet.

milestones.text: learned to do a crisp riff
milestones.post: Riffs now. Clicky, quick, delightful.

milestones.text: tapped out a whole routine from memory
milestones.post: Whole routine from memory. Feet remembered before I did.

milestones.text: performed a tap number in the amateur revue
milestones.post: Tap number at the revue. Shiny shoes, loud floor.

milestones.text: improvised a short tap break and kept it in time
milestones.post: Made up a tap break on the spot. Stayed in time!

milestones.text: danced a tap solo at the end-of-year show
milestones.post: Tap solo. The floor and I had a conversation.

milestones.text: won the tap section of the dance contest
milestones.post: First in tap. My shoes deserve a trophy too.

milestones.text: learned the five positions of the feet
milestones.post: Five positions. Feet pointing in all directions.

milestones.text: got through a whole barre without losing their place
milestones.post: Whole barre, didn't lose my place. Grand victory.

milestones.text: held an arabesque for a full count of eight
milestones.post: Arabesque, count of eight. Wobbled on nine.

milestones.text: managed a clean single pirouette
milestones.post: One clean pirouette. One! Clean!

milestones.text: landed a clean double pirouette
milestones.post: Double pirouette. Going to dream about this.

milestones.text: learned a full variation from Swan Lake
milestones.post: A whole Swan Lake variation. Feeling very swanlike.

milestones.text: danced in the corps at the amateur company's show
milestones.post: In the corps at the show. Perfectly in line.

milestones.text: danced en pointe for the first time
milestones.post: En pointe, for a few seconds. Felt like floating.

milestones.text: danced a solo from The Nutcracker at the winter show
milestones.post: Nutcracker solo at the winter show. Magic.

milestones.text: was cast as a lead in the amateur company's production
milestones.post: Cast as a lead. Rehearsals start tomorrow!

milestones.text: learned the basic bounce and groove
milestones.post: Got the bounce. Mostly. Kind of.

milestones.text: made it through their first hip-hop class at the studio
milestones.post: First hip-hop class. Sweated more than I danced.

milestones.text: picked up a whole combo in a single class
milestones.post: Picked up the whole combo in one class. Feeling fresh.

milestones.text: learned their first top rock steps
milestones.post: Top rock unlocked. Stepping all the way home.

milestones.text: jumped into a cypher and held their own for a few eight-counts
milestones.post: Went into the cypher. Held it down for a bit.

milestones.text: filmed a full routine on their phone and actually liked it
milestones.post: Filmed my routine and didn't cringe. Growth.

milestones.text: performed with their crew at a dance showcase
milestones.post: Crew showcase! We hit every mark.

milestones.text: entered their first dance battle
milestones.post: First battle. Lost, but the crowd was with me.

milestones.text: won a local hip-hop battle
milestones.post: Won the battle. Still buzzing hours later.

milestones.text: choreographed a routine the whole crew performed
milestones.post: The crew danced my choreography. Unreal.

milestones.text: learned the tango walk and the embrace
milestones.post: Walking, but tango walking. Very different, apparently.

milestones.text: sat through their first milonga and danced two tandas
milestones.post: First milonga. Danced twice. Watched a lot.

milestones.text: danced a whole tanda without losing the embrace
milestones.post: Whole tanda, embrace intact. Lovely.

milestones.text: learned the ocho and made it look nearly elegant
milestones.post: Ochos learned. Nearly elegant. Nearly.

milestones.text: danced a smooth giro around the floor
milestones.post: Smooth giro. Felt like the music was moving us.

milestones.text: kept up with a quick milonga tune
milestones.post: Quick milonga, quick feet. Kept up!

milestones.text: danced at a big milonga until closing
milestones.post: Danced until closing. Floor nearly empty, music still playing.

milestones.text: performed a tango at the studio showcase
milestones.post: Tango at the showcase. Dramatic, as tango should be.

milestones.text: won the tango contest at the dance hall
milestones.post: Won the tango contest. Never felt so composed.

milestones.text: was asked to teach the beginners' tango class
milestones.post: Teaching beginners' tango now. Passing it on.

milestones.text: learned the first figures of a reel
milestones.post: First reel figures learned. Lots of spinning.

milestones.text: got through their first barn dance without going the wrong way down the line
milestones.post: Barn dance, right way down the line every time.

milestones.text: remembered every figure of a long country dance
milestones.post: Every figure of the long dance. Memory like a trap.

milestones.text: kept up when the fiddler sped up the tune
milestones.post: The fiddler sped up. So did we. Laughing all the way.

milestones.text: danced every set at the harvest dance
milestones.post: Every set at the harvest dance. Boots worn out.

milestones.text: learned a brand-new dance from the caller in one go
milestones.post: Learned the new dance first try. The caller winked.

milestones.text: led a line of dancers across the village green
milestones.post: Led the line across the green. Felt like a parade.

milestones.text: danced round the maypole without tangling a single ribbon
milestones.post: Maypole done, no ribbon tangled. Remarkable.

milestones.text: called a whole evening of dances for the village
milestones.post: Called the whole evening. Everyone danced. Hoarse now.

milestones.text: was chosen to lead the first dance at the harvest festival
milestones.post: Led the first dance at harvest. Great honour.

milestones.text: made it through a whole dance without stopping
milestones.post: Whole dance, no stopping.

milestones.text: learned the first steps well enough to stop staring at their feet
milestones.post: Eyes up. Mostly.

milestones.text: stopped counting out loud
milestones.post: No more counting under my breath.

milestones.text: danced a whole evening without treading on a single toe
milestones.post: Zero toes trodden on.

milestones.text: learned to find the beat in a new tune
milestones.post: Found the beat on my own.

milestones.text: got through the opening figure without a mistake
milestones.post: Opening figure: clean.

milestones.text: danced with a stranger and kept up
milestones.post: Kept up with a stranger. Proud.

milestones.text: worked out which way to turn without thinking
milestones.post: Left, right, no thinking.

milestones.text: went back for a second dance the same night
milestones.post: Couldn't sit this one out.

milestones.text: practised a step at home until it stuck
milestones.post: Practised in the kitchen. It stuck.

milestones.text: learned a whole new dance in one evening
milestones.post: New dance, learned in a night.

milestones.text: was asked for a second dance by the same partner
milestones.post: Asked back for another. Good sign.

milestones.text: kept time through a fast tune without losing the step
milestones.post: Fast tune, kept up.

milestones.text: learned to lead and to follow
milestones.post: Can lead, can follow.

milestones.text: got through a long set without needing a rest
milestones.post: Whole set, no rest.

milestones.text: remembered every figure of a long dance
milestones.post: Every figure, remembered.

milestones.text: danced at a wedding and held the floor
milestones.post: Wedding dance floor: held.

milestones.text: helped a nervous friend onto the floor
milestones.post: Got a friend dancing. Mission complete.

milestones.text: felt the music instead of thinking about it
milestones.post: Stopped thinking. Started dancing.

milestones.text: added a little flourish of their own
milestones.post: A bit of flair. Just a bit.

milestones.text: learned to dance in a crowded room without bumping into anyone
milestones.post: Crowded floor, no collisions.

milestones.text: was picked to lead a dance at the festival
milestones.post: Leading at the festival!

milestones.text: danced every dance at a long celebration
milestones.post: Every single dance. Feet aching.

milestones.text: learned a tricky turn that took weeks
milestones.post: Weeks for one turn. Worth it.

milestones.text: had their footwork praised by an old hand
milestones.post: An old hand liked my footwork.

milestones.text: danced a solo turn while the room watched
milestones.post: Solo turn. Room watching. Survived.

milestones.text: partnered someone new and made it look easy
milestones.post: Made it look easy. It wasn't.

milestones.text: kept the whole line in step when the music sped up
milestones.post: Kept the line together.

milestones.text: learned three new dances in a single season
milestones.post: Three new ones this season.

milestones.text: danced until the musicians packed up
milestones.post: Last ones on the floor.

milestones.text: was asked for lessons for the first time
milestones.post: Someone asked me for lessons!

milestones.text: kept dancing after a stumble as if it were planned
milestones.post: Stumbled. Made it a move.

milestones.text: was asked to open the dancing at a celebration
milestones.post: Opened the dancing. Heart pounding.

milestones.text: taught a whole room a new dance
milestones.post: Taught the room. It worked.

milestones.text: danced in a performance in front of a crowd
milestones.post: Danced for a crowd tonight.

milestones.text: made up a short dance that others now dance
milestones.post: My little dance, being danced.

milestones.text: won a dance contest at the fair
milestones.post: Won the dance contest!

milestones.text: was trusted to call the figures for a whole evening
milestones.post: Called the whole evening.

milestones.text: helped get the dancers ready for a big occasion
milestones.post: Got everyone ready. Proud.

milestones.text: danced every part of a long dance, leading and following
milestones.post: Every part, both sides.

milestones.text: was invited to dance at a grand occasion
milestones.post: Invited to a grand occasion. To dance!

milestones.text: was given the place of honour at the head of the line
milestones.post: Place of honour. Wow.

milestones.text: became the one everyone watches on the floor
milestones.post: Apparently I'm worth watching.

milestones.text: taught dancing to a whole season of beginners
milestones.post: A season of beginners, all dancing now.

milestones.text: led the dancing at the biggest celebration of the year
milestones.post: Led the biggest night of the year.

milestones.text: was asked to teach at a hall in another town
milestones.post: Teaching in another town!

milestones.text: made the old hands stop and applaud
milestones.post: The old hands applauded. I may cry.

milestones.text: danced with the best dancer in town and kept pace
milestones.post: Kept pace with the best.

milestones.text: won the dance contest two years running
milestones.post: Two years running.

milestones.text: made up a dance now done at every celebration in town
milestones.post: My dance, at every party.

milestones.text: could pick up any dance at first sight
milestones.post: Show me once. That's all.

milestones.text: was asked to dance before honoured guests
milestones.post: Danced for honoured guests.

milestones.text: danced a whole night without sitting one out
milestones.post: Didn't sit one out.

milestones.text: picked up the dance everyone was doing on the first try
milestones.post: First try!

milestones.text: got the whole room dancing
milestones.post: Whole room up.

milestones.text: was asked to lead the dancing for the evening
milestones.post: Leading the dancing!

milestones.text: became the one everyone wants to dance with
milestones.post: Dance card full.

sessions.text: Went over the same few steps until they felt natural.
Danced until their feet ached pleasantly.
Laughed at their own mistakes and kept going.
Practised the hardest turn a dozen times.
Worked on keeping their posture tall.
Let the music carry them for a while.
Learned a little variation to try next time.
Danced with three different people and enjoyed each one.
Spent ages on footwork and loved it.
Got the timing right on the tricky bar at last.
Hummed the tune all the way home.
Took it slowly and paid attention to the details.
Ran the whole sequence twice without a slip.
Swapped tips with another dancer at the end.
Felt a little rusty at first, then warmed up.
Kept the steps small and neat.
Came home light on their feet.
Practised in front of a mirror to check their lines.
